headline: Odd-Eyes Pendulum Dragon
title: Odd-Eyes Pendulum Dragon Explained | What It Does and How to Use It | Yu-Gi-Oh
video_script: This is Odd-Eyes Pendulum Dragon. What is it? It is a Level seven DARK Dragon Pendulum Monster with two thousand five hundred attack. What does it do? Battle damage it deals to your opponent is doubled. As a Pendulum Scale it can reduce the battle damage you take from your Pendulum Monster's battles to zero, and can search a Pendulum Monster with fifteen hundred or less attack. How do you use it? Use it both as a monster and as a Pendulum Scale. It is in Starter Deck: Yuya. Which card should I explain next? Comment below!
